en.headline: Three more imported dengue cases recorded; yearly total reaches 31
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said two of the latest patients had travelled to the Philippines and one to the Chinese Mainland and Vietnam during the incubation period.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health recorded three imported dengue fever cases between 4 and 10 September, bringing the total for the year to 31, including 29 imported and two local cases.

Two of the patients had travelled to the Philippines during the incubation period, while the third had visited the Chinese Mainland and Vietnam. No new chikungunya fever cases were recorded in the same period; the yearly total for that disease remains two, both imported.

The centre urged the public to take anti-mosquito measures both locally and when travelling, and to seek medical attention promptly if fever or other symptoms develop after returning from endemic areas.

zh.headline: 新增3宗外地傳入登革熱 今年累計31宗
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布，9月4日至10日錄得3宗輸入個案，兩名病人潛伏期內到過菲律賓，另一人到過內地及越南。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日公布，上周五至昨日錄得3宗外地傳入登革熱個案，本港今年暫時累計31宗，包括29宗輸入及兩宗本地感染。
兩名病人於潛伏期內曾到菲律賓，另一名則到過中國內地及越南。同期間沒有新增基孔肯雅熱個案，今年累計仍為兩宗，全部屬輸入。
中心呼籲市民無論在本地或外遊，都應注意防蚊及環境衞生，從流行地區回港後如出現發燒等病徵，應盡快求醫。
